cases.narrative: On 10/19/1980, her nude body was found in the Embarras River with her head, hands and feet missing. He told police he hit her in the head with a coal poker and kept her body wrapped in a blanket in the attic for 2 days until he began to smell and odor. He dismembered her at the river and took her head, hands and feet with him, burned them and disposed of them in the Vermillion River. Her head, hands and feet have never been found.
